parent_objective: design L3 recurrent recipe repair after M543/M544 instability evidence

public_gates: pre-register L3 repair candidates and diagnostic controls
define checkpoint selection and route-health gates before public frozen-source eval
preserve L2 as the finite-window baseline
do not train or promote checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune L3 directly to M543 public rows and then claim private evidence
do not discard L2 because the target is recurrent belief
do not run repaired training before repair criteria are documented
hypothesis: The next step should repair recurrent optimization and checkpoint-selection discipline for L3 before more matched variance training, while preserving L2 as the finite-window baseline.
success_criteria: repair candidates are listed with allowed config changes
route-health and public diagnostic gates are defined
comparison back to L0/L2 is explicitly required after repair
failure_criteria: design allows unbounded per-level tuning without later re-matching
design treats public rows as private evidence

commands.name: design_only
commands.command: Write L3 recurrent recipe repair design; no training.

decision_rule: M545 is a design milestone. Passing it admits controlled L3 repair configs; it does not train or promote a checkpoint.
